title: Madhya-khanda, part 5 (portion 28)
html:
The section "Meeting Nityananda": the name of Srivasa; Murari's Raghuvira-ashtaka and the name "Ramadasa"; service to Srivasa is worship of the Lord; the search for Nityananda and the meeting in the house of Nandana Acharya; the glory of Nityananda; Shachi accepts Nityananda as her son; in Srivasa's house the Lord reveals to Nityananda His six-armed, four-armed and two-armed forms

Meeting Nityananda

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. One day Sriman Mahaprabhu asked Srivasa Pandita the meaning of his name and Himself revealed its sense: "Srivasa is the abode (avasa) of devotion (shri)." Then, when at the Lord's command Murari recited the Raghuvira-ashtaka, Sriman Mahaprabhu wrote the name "Ramadasa" on his forehead and showed him the form of Rama whom he worshipped. Having instructed Sri Rama Pandita to serve his brother Srivasa, a supreme devotee (parama-bhagavata), Sriman Mahaprabhu sent the devotees to look for Sriman Nityananda Prabhu. [Learning] that Sriman Nityananda Prabhu was staying in the house of Nandana Acharya, Mahaprabhu came there with His associates and met Him; before everyone He glorified the greatness of Nityananda Prabhu and [explained] the way to prema-bhakti for Krishna. When Sriman Nityananda Prabhu was taking His meal in the house of Srivasa Pandita, Sriman Mahaprabhu revealed to Him His six-armed, four-armed and two-armed forms1.

Raga — any (yatha-raga); disha: "Ah, my life — Gorachand!"

তবে নিজঘরে প্রভু বসি' দিব্যাসনে ।
চৌদিগে বেঢ়িয়া আছে নিজভক্তজনে ॥ ১ ॥

tabe nijaghare prabhu basi' dibyāsane |
caudige beṛhiẏā āche nijabhaktajane || 1 ||

tabe — then; nija-ghare — in His own house; prabhu — the Lord; basi — sitting; divya-asane — on a divine seat; chaudige — all around; bedhiya achhe — are surrounding; nija-bhakta-jane — His own devotees

1Then the Lord was sitting at home on a divine seat,
and around Him were His devotees.

শ্রীবাস দেখিয়া প্রভু কৈল এক উক্তি ।
তোমার নামের তুমি কি জান ব্যুৎপত্তি ॥ ২ ॥

śrībāsa dekhiẏā prabhu kaila eka ukti |
tomāra nāmera tumi ki jāna byutpatti || 2 ||

shrivasa dekhiya — seeing Srivasa; prabhu kaila eka ukti — the Lord made a remark; tomara namera — of your name; tumi ki jana — do you know; vyutpatti — the derivation

2Seeing Srivasa, the Lord said:
"Do you know how your name is formed?

শ্রী-ভকতির তুমি কেবল আবাস ।
এতেক বলিয়ে তোর নাম সে শ্রীবাস ॥ ৩ ॥

śrī-bhakatira tumi kebala ābāsa |
eteka baliẏe tora nāma se śrībāsa || 3 ||

shri-bhakatira — of Shri, that is, of devotion; tumi kevala avasa — you are the very abode; eteka baliye — therefore I say; tora nama se shrivasa — your name is Srivasa

3You are the very abode (avasa) of Shri — of devotion;
that is why I say: your name is Srivasa."2

তবে ত কহিল প্রভু দেখি' গোপীনাথ ।
আমার ভকত তুমি বুল মোর সাথ ॥ ৪ ॥

tabe ta kahila prabhu dekhi' gopīnātha |
āmāra bhakata tumi bula mora sātha || 4 ||

tabe ta kahila prabhu — then the Lord said; dekhi gopinatha — seeing Gopinatha; amara bhakata tumi — you are My devotee; bula mora satha — go about with Me

4Then, seeing Gopinatha, the Lord said:
"You are My devotee — go about with Me."3

মুরারি দেখিয়া প্রভু বোলে পুনর্বার ।
পঢ়হ আপন শ্লোক শুনিব তোমার ॥ ৫ ॥

murāri dekhiẏā prabhu bole punarbāra |
paṛhaha āpana śloka śuniba tomāra || 5 ||

murari dekhiya — seeing Murari; prabhu bole punarvara — the Lord says again; padhaha apana shloka — recite your own verses; shuniba tomara — I shall hear you

5Seeing Murari, the Lord says again:
"Recite your verses — I shall listen to you."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সেই মুরারি চতুর ।
পঢ়য়ে কবিত্ব নিজ শুনয়ে ঠাকুর ॥ ৬ ॥

e bola śuniñā sei murāri catura |
paṛhaẏe kabitba nija śunaẏe ṭhākura || 6 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing these words; sei murari chatura — that skilful Murari; padhaye kavitva nija — recites his own poetry; shunaye thakura — the Thakura listens

6Hearing these words, the skilful Murari
recites his own poetry, and the Thakura listens.

So in the Sri Chaitanya-charita composed by Sri Murari Gupta, second prakrama, seventh sarga:

রাজৎকিরীটমণিদীধিতিদীপিতাশম্
উদ্যদ্বৃহস্পতিকবিপ্রতিমে বহন্তম্ ।
দ্বে কুণ্ডলেঽঙ্করহিতেন্দুসমানবক্ত্রং
রামং জগত্ত্রয়গুরুং সততং ভজামি ॥ ৭ ॥

rājatkirīṭamaṇidīdhitidīpitāśam
udyadbṛhaspatikabipratime bahantam |
dbe kuṇḍale'ṅkarahitendusamānabaktraṃ
rāmaṃ jagattraẏaguruṃ satataṃ bhajāmi || 7 ||

rajat-kirita-mani-didhiti-dipita-asham — who lights up the quarters with the rays of the gems of His gleaming crown; udyat-brihaspati-kavi-pratime — resembling the rising Brihaspati and Kavi; dve kundale — two earrings; vahantam — wearing; anka-rahita-indu-samana-vaktram — whose face is like a spotless moon; ramam — Rama; jagat-traya-gurum — the teacher of the three worlds; satatam — ever; bhajami — I worship

7"The rays of the gems of His gleaming crown light up the quarters; He wears earrings like the rising Brihaspati and Kavi; His face is like a spotless moon. Rama, the teacher of the three worlds, I worship ever.

উদ্যদ্বিভাকরমরীচিবিবোধিতাব্জ-
নেত্রং সুবিম্বদশনচ্ছদচারুনাসম্ ।
শুভ্রাংশুরশ্মিপরিনির্জিতচারুহাসং
রামং জগত্ত্রয়গুরুং সততং ভজামি ॥ ৮ ॥

udyadbibhākaramarīcibibodhitābja-
netraṃ subimbadaśanacchadacārunāsam |
śubhrāṃśuraśmiparinirjitacāruhāsaṃ
rāmaṃ jagattraẏaguruṃ satataṃ bhajāmi || 8 ||

udyat-vibhakara-marichi-vibodhita-abja-netram — with eyes like lotuses awakened by the rays of the rising sun; su-bimba-dashana-chchhada-charu-nasam — with lips like ripe bimba fruit and a lovely nose; shubhramshu-rashmi-parinirjita-charu-hasam — whose lovely smile outshines the moonbeams; ramam — Rama; jagat-traya-gurum — the teacher of the three worlds; satatam bhajami — I ever worship

8His eyes are like lotuses awakened by the rays of the rising sun; His lips are like ripe bimba fruit, His nose is lovely; His charming smile outshines the moonbeams. Rama, the teacher of the three worlds, I worship ever."4

এইমতে রঘুবীরাষ্টক শ্লোক শুনি' ।
মুরারি-মস্তকে পদ দিল ত আপনি ॥ ৯ ॥

eimate raghubīrāṣṭaka śloka śuni' |
murāri-mastake pada dila ta āpani || 9 ||

eimate — thus; raghuviraashtaka shloka shuni — hearing the verses of the Raghuvira-ashtaka; murari-mastake — on Murari's head; pada dila ta apani — Himself placed His foot

9Having thus heard the verses of the Raghuvira-ashtaka,
[the Lord] Himself placed His foot on Murari's head.

'রামদাস' বলি' নাম লিখিলা কপালে ।
মোর পরসাদে তুমি 'রামদাস' হৈলে ॥ ১০ ॥

'rāmadāsa' bali' nāma likhilā kapāle |
mora parasāde tumi 'rāmadāsa' haile || 10 ||

ramadasa bali — saying "Ramadasa"; nama likhila kapale — wrote the name on his forehead; mora parasade — by My grace; tumi ramadasa haile — you have become Ramadasa

10He wrote the name "Ramadasa" on his forehead:
"By My grace you have become Ramadasa.

রঘুনাথ বিনে তুমি তিলেক না জীয় ।
মুঞি তোর রঘুনাথ জানিহ নিশ্চয় ॥ ১১ ॥

raghunātha bine tumi tileka nā jīẏa |
muñi tora raghunātha jāniha niścaẏa || 11 ||

raghunatha vine — without Raghunatha; tumi tileka na jiya — you do not live even a moment; munyi tora raghunatha — I am your Raghunatha; janiha nishchaya — know for certain

11Without Raghunatha you do not live even a moment;
know for certain: I am your Raghunatha."5

ইহা বলি' রামরূপ দেখাইল তারে ।
জানকী-সহিত সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গ সব মেলে ॥ ১২ ॥

ihā bali' rāmarūpa dekhāila tāre |
jānakī-sahita sāṅgopāṅga saba mele || 12 ||

iha bali — saying this; rama-rupa dekhaila tare — showed him the form of Rama; janaki-sahita — together with Janaki (Sita); sangopanga saba mele — with all His associates and attendants

12Saying this, He showed him the form of Rama —
with Janaki, with all His associates and attendants.

স্তব করে মুরারি পড়িয়া পদতলে ।
জয় জয় রঘুবীর শচীর কোঙরে ॥ ১৩ ॥

staba kare murāri paṛiẏā padatale |
jaẏa jaẏa raghubīra śacīra koṅare || 13 ||

stava kare murari — Murari offers praise; padiya padatale — falling at His feet; jaya jaya raghuvira — glory, glory to Raghuvira; shachira kongare — to Shachi's son

13Falling at His feet, Murari offers praise:
"Glory, glory to Raghuvira, the son of Shachi!"

বারবার উঠে পড়ে লোটাঞা ধরণী ।
বহুবিধ স্তব করে অনুনয়-বাণী ॥ ১৪ ॥

bārabāra uṭhe paṛe loṭāñā dharaṇī |
bahubidha staba kare anunaẏa-bāṇī || 14 ||

barabara uthe pade — again and again rises and falls; lotanya dharani — rolling on the ground; bahuvidha stava kare — offers many kinds of praise; anunaya-vani — humble entreaties

14Again and again he rises and falls, rolling on the ground,
offering many kinds of praise and humble entreaties.

মুরারিকে কৃপা করি' বলিলা বচন ।
আমার ভকতি বিনু না জানিহ আন ॥ ১৫ ॥

murārike kṛpā kari' balilā bacana |
āmāra bhakati binu nā jāniha āna || 15 ||

murarike — to Murari; kripa kari — mercifully; balila bachana — spoke words; amara bhakati vinu — apart from devotion to Me; na janiha ana — know nothing else

15The Lord mercifully said to Murari:
"Know nothing but devotion to Me.

যদি তোর ইষ্ট আমি হই রঘুনাথ ।
তথাপিহ রস আস্বাদিহ রাধানাথ ॥ ১৬ ॥

yadi tora iṣṭa āmi hai raghunātha |
tathāpiha rasa āsbādiha rādhānātha || 16 ||

yadi tora ishta ami hai raghunatha — though your chosen Deity is I, Raghunatha; tathapiha — still; rasa asvadiha — taste the rasa; radhanatha — of the Lord of Radha

16Though your chosen Deity is I, Raghunatha,
still, taste the rasa of the Lord of Radha.

সংকীর্তন-ধর্মে রাধাকৃষ্ণ গাও যাইয়া ।
করিবে আমাতে ভক্তি শুন মন দিয়া ॥ ১৭ ॥

saṃkīrtana-dharme rādhākṛṣṇa gāo yāiẏā |
karibe āmāte bhakti śuna mana diẏā || 17 ||

sankirtana-dharme — by the dharma of sankirtana; radhakrishna gao yaiya — go and sing of Radha and Krishna; karibe amate bhakti — you will render devotion to Me; shuna mana diya — listen attentively

17Go and sing of Radha and Krishna, following the dharma of sankirtana —
thus you will render devotion to Me; listen attentively."6

ইহা বলি' শ্লোক এক পঢ়িলেক নিজ ।
মোর এক শ্লোক শুন শ্রীনিবাস দ্বিজ ॥ ১৮ ॥

ihā bali' śloka eka paṛhileka nija |
mora eka śloka śuna śrīnibāsa dbija || 18 ||

iha bali — saying this; shloka eka padhileka nija — Himself recited a verse; mora eka shloka — one verse of Mine; shuna shrinivasa dvija — hear, brahmana Srinivasa

18Saying this, He Himself recited a verse:
"Hear one verse of Mine, brahmana Srinivasa."

So [in the Srimad-Bhagavata (11.14.20)]:

ন সাধয়তি মাং যোগো ন সাংখ্যং ধর্ম উদ্ধব ।
ন স্বাধ্যায়স্তপস্ত্যাগো যথা ভক্তির্মমোর্জিতা ॥ ১৯ ॥

na sādhaẏati māṃ yogo na sāṃkhyaṃ dharma uddhaba |
na sbādhyāẏastapastyāgo yathā bhaktirmamorjitā || 19 ||

na sadhayati mam — do not win Me over; yogah — yoga; na sankhyam — nor Sankhya; dharmah — dharma; uddhava — O Uddhava; na svadhyayah — nor Vedic study; tapah — austerity; tyagah — renunciation; yatha — as; bhaktih mama urjita — mighty devotion to Me

19"Neither yoga nor Sankhya nor dharma, O Uddhava, neither Vedic study nor austerity nor renunciation win Me over as does mighty devotion to Me."

পঢ়িয়া কহিল শুন সব নিজজন ।
তোমরা করিহ এইমত আচরণ ॥ ২০ ॥

paṛhiẏā kahila śuna saba nijajana |
tomarā kariha eimata ācaraṇa || 20 ||

padhiya kahila — having recited, He said; shuna saba nijajana — hear, all My own; tomara kariha — you should practise; eimata acharana — such conduct

20Having recited it, He said: "Hear, all My own:
act in this way.

শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিতের কথা অনুসরি' ।
করিহ আমাতে ভক্তি সুখ পাবে বড় ॥ ২১ ॥

śrīnibāsa-paṇḍitera kathā anusari' |
kariha āmāte bhakti sukha pābe baṛa || 21 ||

shrinivasa-panditera katha anusari — following the words of Srinivasa Pandita; kariha amate bhakti — render devotion to Me; sukha pabe bada — you will find great happiness

21Following the words of Srinivasa Pandita,
render devotion to Me — you will find great happiness.

শ্রীরাম-পণ্ডিত শুন আমার বচন ।
তোমার জ্যেষ্ঠের সেবা আমার অর্চন ॥ ২২ ॥

śrīrāma-paṇḍita śuna āmāra bacana |
tomāra jyeṣṭhera sebā āmāra arcana || 22 ||

shrirama-pandita — Sri Rama Pandita; shuna amara bachana — hear My words; tomara jyeshthera seva — service to your elder brother; amara archana — is worship of Me

22Sri Rama Pandita, hear My words:
service to your elder brother is worship of Me.

এতেক জানিঞা কর শ্রীবাসের সেবা ।
ইহা হৈতে পাবে তুমি মোর পদ-প্রভা ॥ ২৩ ॥

eteka jāniñā kara śrībāsera sebā |
ihā haite pābe tumi mora pada-prabhā || 23 ||

eteka janinya — knowing this; kara shrivasera seva — serve Srivasa; iha haite — through this; pabe tumi — you will attain; mora pada-prabha — the radiance of My feet

23Knowing this, serve Srivasa:
through this you will attain the radiance of My feet."7

এতেক কহিল প্রভু ভকতবৎসল ।
করুণ-অরুণ আঁখি করে ছলছল ॥ ২৪ ॥

eteka kahila prabhu bhakatabatsala |
karuṇa-aruṇa āṁkhi kare chalachala || 24 ||

eteka kahila — thus spoke; prabhu bhakatavatsala — the Lord, affectionate to His devotees; karuna-aruna ankhi — His eyes, reddened with compassion; kare chhalachhala — brim with tears

24So spoke the Lord, affectionate to His devotees;
His eyes, reddened with compassion, brimmed with tears.

তবে সেই শ্রীনিবাস-পণ্ডিত চতুর ।
নিবেদন কৈল দুগ্ধ ভুঞ্জয়ে ঠাকুর ॥ ২৫ ॥

tabe sei śrīnibāsa-paṇḍita catura |
nibedana kaila dugdha bhuñjaẏe ṭhākura || 25 ||

tabe — then; sei shrinivasa-pandita chatura — the skilful Srinivasa Pandita; nivedana kaila dugdha — offered milk; bhunjaye thakura — the Thakura partakes

25Then the skilful Srinivasa Pandita
offered milk, and the Thakura partakes of it.

গন্ধ চন্দন মালা সুবাসিত পূগ ।
ধূপ দীপ নিবেদন করিল সম্মুখ ॥ ২৬ ॥

gandha candana mālā subāsita pūga |
dhūpa dīpa nibedana karila sammukha || 26 ||

gandha chandana mala — scents, sandal, garlands; suvasita puga — fragrant betel nut; dhupa dipa — incense and lamps; nivedana karila sammukha — offered before Him

26Scents, sandal, garlands, fragrant betel,
incense and lamps he offered before Him.

গ্রহণ করিল প্রভু আনন্দিত মনে ।
অবশেষ দিল যত নিজভক্তজনে ॥ ২৭ ॥

grahaṇa karila prabhu ānandita mane |
abaśeṣa dila yata nijabhaktajane || 27 ||

grahana karila prabhu — the Lord accepted; anandita mane — with a joyful heart; avashesha dila — gave the remnants; yata nija-bhakta-jane — to all His devotees

27The Lord joyfully accepted [the offerings]
and gave the remnants to all His devotees.8

এইমতে কৌতুকে সকল নিশা গেল ।
প্রভাতে উঠিয়া প্রভু ঘরেরে চলিল ॥ ২৮ ॥

eimate kautuke sakala niśā gela |
prabhāte uṭhiẏā prabhu gharere calila || 28 ||

eimate — thus; kautuke — in joyous play; sakala nisha gela — the whole night passed; prabhate uthiya — rising at dawn; prabhu gharere chalila — the Lord went home

28Thus in joyous play the whole night passed;
at dawn the Lord rose and went home.

স্নান-দেবার্চনা সভে কৈলা নিজঘরে ।
পুনরপি গেলা পাদাম্বুজ দেখিবারে ॥ ২৯ ॥

snāna-debārcanā sabhe kailā nijaghare |
punarapi gelā pādāmbuja dekhibāre || 29 ||

snana-devarchana — bathing and worship of the Deity; sabhe kaila nijaghare — all performed in their own homes; punarapi gela — again they went; padambuja dekhibare — to see [His] lotus feet

29All performed their bathing and worship of the Deity in their own homes
and came again to see His lotus feet.

হাসিয়া কহিল প্রভু শুন অদ্ভুত ।
আইলা শ্রীপাদ নিত্যানন্দ অবধূত ॥ ৩০ ॥

hāsiẏā kahila prabhu śuna adbhuta |
āilā śrīpāda nityānanda abadhūta || 30 ||

hasiya kahila prabhu — laughing, the Lord said; shuna adbhuta — hear a wonder; aila shripada — Shripada has come; nityananda avadhuta — Nityananda the Avadhuta

30Laughing, the Lord said: "Hear a wonderful thing:
Shripada Nityananda Avadhuta has come!

তাঁহার মহিমা-তত্ত্ব কে কহিতে জানে ।
বড় পুণ্য-ভাগ্যে আজি দেখিব চরণে ॥ ৩১ ॥

tāṁhāra mahimā-tattba ke kahite jāne |
baṛa puṇya-bhāgye āji dekhiba caraṇe || 31 ||

tanhara mahima-tattva — the truth of His glory; ke kahite jane — who knows how to tell; bada punya-bhagye — by great merit and fortune; aji dekhiba charane — today I shall see [His] feet

31Who knows how to tell the truth of His glory?
By great merit and fortune I shall see His feet today.

হের রাম নারায়ণ মুরারি মুকুন্দ ।
সত্বরে জানহ কোথা আছে নিত্যানন্দ ॥ ৩২ ॥

hera rāma nārāẏaṇa murāri mukunda |
satbare jānaha kothā āche nityānanda || 32 ||

hera — ho; rama narayana murari mukunda — Rama, Narayana, Murari, Mukunda; satvare janaha — quickly find out; kotha achhe nityananda — where Nityananda is

32Ho, Rama, Narayana, Murari, Mukunda,
quickly find out where Nityananda is."9

হেনরূপে মহাপ্রভু আজ্ঞা যবে কৈল ।
সত্বরে চলিয়া গ্রাম-দক্ষিণে চাহিল ॥ ৩৩ ॥

henarūpe mahāprabhu ājñā yabe kaila |
satbare caliẏā grāma-dakṣiṇe cāhila || 33 ||

henarupe — thus; mahaprabhu ajna yabe kaila — when Mahaprabhu gave the order; satvare chaliya — going quickly; grama-dakshine chahila — they searched south of the village

33When Mahaprabhu gave this order,
they set off at once and searched south of the village.

বিচার করিয়া লাগ না পাইল তার ।
পাদাম্বুজ-সন্নিকটে আইলা আরবার ॥ ৩৪ ॥

bicāra kariẏā lāga nā pāila tāra |
pādāmbuja-sannikaṭe āilā ārabāra || 34 ||

vichara kariya — having searched; laga na paila tara — they found no trace of Him; padambuja-sannikate — near the lotus feet; aila aravara — they came back

34They searched but found no trace of Him
and came back again to His lotus feet.

করজোড় করি' কহে ঠাকুরের আগে ।
বিচার করিয়া প্রভু না পাইল লাগে ॥ ৩৫ ॥

karajoṛa kari' kahe ṭhākurera āge |
bicāra kariẏā prabhu nā pāila lāge || 35 ||

karajoda kari — with joined palms; kahe thakurera age — they say before the Thakura; vichara kariya — having searched; prabhu — O Lord; na paila lage — we found no trace

35With joined palms they say before the Thakura:
"Lord, we searched but found no trace of Him."

পুনরপি কহে প্রভু শুন সর্বজন ।
বিচার করহ সভে আপন-আশ্রম ॥ ৩৬ ॥

punarapi kahe prabhu śuna sarbajana |
bicāra karaha sabhe āpana-āśrama || 36 ||

punarapi kahe prabhu — again the Lord says; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; vichara karaha sabhe — all of you consider (go); apana-ashrama — [to] your own dwelling

36Again the Lord says: "Hear, all of you:
now go, each of you, to your own dwelling."10

প্রভুর আজ্ঞায় সভে চলিলা সত্বর ।
একে একে সভে গেলা আপনার ঘর ॥ ৩৭ ॥

prabhura ājñāẏa sabhe calilā satbara |
eke eke sabhe gelā āpanāra ghara || 37 ||

prabhura ajnaya — at the Lord's command; sabhe chalila satvara — all set off at once; eke eke — one by one; sabhe gela apanara ghara — all went to their own homes

37At the Lord's command all set off at once
and one by one went to their own homes.

সন্ধ্যাকালে সন্ধ্যা করি' একত্র হইয়া ।
প্রভু-বিদ্যমানে সভে মিলিলা আসিয়া ॥ ৩৮ ॥

sandhyākāle sandhyā kari' ekatra haiẏā |
prabhu-bidyamāne sabhe mililā āsiẏā || 38 ||

sandhya-kale — in the evening; sandhya kari — having performed the evening prayers; ekatra haiya — gathering together; prabhu-vidyamane — into the Lord's presence; sabhe milila asiya — all came and assembled

38In the evening, having performed the evening prayers, they gathered together
and all came together to the Lord.

পথে যাইতে 'মুরারি' বলিয়া ডাকে পহুঁ ।
না দেখিলে অবধূত বলি' হাসে লহু ॥ ৩৯ ॥

pathe yāite 'murāri' baliẏā ḍāke pahuṁ |
nā dekhile abadhūta bali' hāse lahu || 39 ||

pathe yaite — going along the road; murari baliya — saying "Murari!"; dake pahu — the Lord calls; na dekhile avadhuta — you did not see the Avadhuta; bali hase lahu — He says, laughing gently

39Going along the road, the Lord calls: "Murari!" —
"You did not see the Avadhuta," He says, and laughs gently.

নন্দন-আচার্য-ঘরে আছে মহাশয় ।
আমিহ যাইব তথা কহিল নিশ্চয় ॥ ৪০ ॥

nandana-ācārya-ghare āche mahāśaẏa |
āmiha yāiba tathā kahila niścaẏa || 40 ||

nandana-acharya-ghare — in the house of Nandana Acharya; achhe mahashaya — the great soul is staying; amiha yaiba tatha — I too shall go there; kahila nishchaya — He said firmly

40"The great soul is staying in the house of Nandana Acharya;
I too shall go there," He said firmly.

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে হরষিত হঞা ।
চলিলা ঠাকুর-সঙ্গে জয় জয় দিয়া ॥ ৪১ ॥

e bola śuniñā sabhe haraṣita hañā |
calilā ṭhākura-saṅge jaẏa jaẏa diẏā || 41 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing these words; sabhe harashita hanya — all, rejoicing; chalila thakura-sange — went with the Thakura; jaya jaya diya — crying "Jaya, jaya!"

41Hearing these words, all rejoiced
and went with the Thakura, crying: "Jaya, jaya!"

পথে যাইতে ঘন ঘন হরি হরি বোলে ।
গণ্ড পুলকিত কণ্ঠ গদগদ রোলে ॥ ৪২ ॥

pathe yāite ghana ghana hari hari bole |
gaṇḍa pulakita kaṇṭha gadagada role || 42 ||

pathe yaite — going along the road; ghana ghana — again and again; hari hari bole — cries "Hari, Hari!"; ganda pulakita — His cheeks thrill; kantha gadagada role — His voice falters

42Going along the road, again and again He cries: "Hari, Hari!";
His cheeks thrill, His voice falters.

নয়নে গলয়ে নীর সাত-পাঁচ-ধারা ।
চলিতে না পারে প্রেমে সোণার কিশোরা ॥ ৪৩ ॥

naẏane galaẏe nīra sāta-pāṁca-dhārā |
calite nā pāre preme soṇāra kiśorā || 43 ||

nayane galaye nira — tears stream from His eyes; sata-pancha-dhara — in many streams; chalite na pare — cannot walk; preme — from prema; sonara kishora — the golden Youth

43Tears stream from His eyes in many streams;
from prema the golden Youth cannot walk.

ক্ষণে সিংহ-পরাক্রমে পদ চারি যায় ।
মত্ত করিবর যেন উলটি' না চায় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

kṣaṇe siṃha-parākrame pada cāri yāẏa |
matta karibara yena ulaṭi' nā cāẏa || 44 ||

kshane — at moments; simha-parakrame — with a lion's prowess; pada chari yaya — goes four steps; matta karivara yena — like a maddened elephant; ulati na chaya — does not look back

44Now with a lion's prowess He goes four steps —
like a maddened elephant that does not look back;

নব-জলধরে যেন গম্ভীর নিনাদ ।
ঘন ঘন হুহুঙ্কার আনন্দ-উন্মাদ ॥ ৪৫ ॥

naba-jaladhare yena gambhīra nināda |
ghana ghana huhuṅkāra ānanda-unmāda || 45 ||

nava-jaladhare yena — as of a new raincloud; gambhira ninada — a deep rumble; ghana ghana huhunkara — again and again the roar "hum!"; ananda-unmada — intoxication of bliss

45now, like the deep rumble of a new raincloud,
again and again He roars "hum!", intoxicated with bliss.

এইমনে আনন্দে সানন্দে চলি' যায় ।
দেখিল ত অবধূত নিত্যানন্দরায় ॥ ৪৬ ॥

eimane ānande sānande cali' yāẏa |
dekhila ta abadhūta nityānandarāẏa || 46 ||

eimane — thus; anande sanande — in joy and delight; chali yaya — He goes on; dekhila ta — He saw; avadhuta nityananda-raya — the Avadhuta Nityananda-raya

46So in joy and delight He goes on,
and He saw the Avadhuta Nityananda-raya.

আরক্ত গৌরাঙ্গ-কান্তি পরম সুন্দর ।
ঝলমল অলঙ্কারে অঙ্গ মনোহর ॥ ৪৭ ॥

ārakta gaurāṅga-kānti parama sundara |
jhalamala alaṅkāre aṅga manohara || 47 ||

arakta gauranga-kanti — a golden body with a reddish glow; parama sundara — supremely beautiful; jhalamala alankare — with glittering ornaments; anga manohara — His body is enchanting

47His body is golden with a reddish glow, supremely beautiful;
an enchanting body in glittering ornaments.

কটিতটে পীতবাস বিরাজিত শোভা ।
শিরে লটপটি পাগ চম্পকের আভা ॥ ৪৮ ॥

kaṭitaṭe pītabāsa birājita śobhā |
śire laṭapaṭi pāga campakera ābhā || 48 ||

katitate — on His hips; pita-vasa — yellow cloth; virajita shobha — shines beautifully; shire — on His head; latapati paga — a loosely tied turban; champakera abha — of champaka hue

48Yellow cloth shines on His hips,
on His head a loosely tied turban of champaka hue.

চলিতে নূপুর পদে ঝনঝনি শুনি ।
কুরঙ্গ-নয়নী-চিত্ত-তরল-সন্ধানী ॥ ৪৯ ॥

calite nūpura pade jhanajhani śuni |
kuraṅga-naẏanī-citta-tarala-sandhānī || 49 ||

chalite — as He walks; nupura pade — the anklets on His feet; jhanajhani shuni — are heard jingling; kuranga-nayani-chitta-tarala-sandhani — setting the hearts of doe-eyed women aquiver

49As He walks, the bells on His feet are heard jingling,
setting the hearts of doe-eyed women aquiver.

হাসিতে বিজুরী যেন খসিয়া পড়িছে ।
কামিনী আপন লাজ তাহাতেই দিছে ॥ ৫০ ॥

hāsite bijurī yena khasiẏā paṛiche |
kāminī āpana lāja tāhātei diche || 50 ||

hasite — when He laughs; bijuri yena — as if lightning; khasiya padichhe — is falling down; kamini — women; apana laja — their own modesty; tahatei dichhe — give up to it then and there

50When He laughs, it is as if lightning were falling from the sky:
women give up their modesty to it then and there.

মেঘ জিনি' গরজে গম্ভীর শব্দ শুনি ।
কলি-মত্ত-হাথীর দমন সিংহধ্বনি ॥ ৫১ ॥

megha jini' garaje gambhīra śabda śuni |
kali-matta-hāthīra damana siṃhadhbani || 51 ||

megha jini — surpassing the clouds; garaje — He thunders; gambhira shabda shuni — a deep sound is heard; kali-matta-hathira — of the maddened elephant of Kali; damana simha-dhvani — a lion's roar that tames

51His roar is heard, deeper than thunder —
a lion's roar that tames the maddened elephant of Kali.

মাতল-কুঞ্জর যেন গমন সুন্দর ।
প্রসন্ন-বদনে প্রেমধারা নিরন্তর ॥ ৫২ ॥

mātala-kuñjara yena gamana sundara |
prasanna-badane premadhārā nirantara || 52 ||

matala-kunjara yena — like a maddened elephant's; gamana sundara — a beautiful gait; prasanna-vadane — on His serene face; prema-dhara nirantara — ceaseless streams of prema

52His gait is beautiful, like a maddened elephant's;
on His serene face are ceaseless streams of prema.

পুলকে আকুল তনু প্রেমে ডগমগি ।
কম্প-স্বেদ-আদি ভাবে রস-অনুরাগী ॥ ৫৩ ॥

pulake ākula tanu preme ḍagamagi |
kampa-sbeda-ādi bhābe rasa-anurāgī || 53 ||

pulake akula tanu — His body overcome with thrills; preme dagamagi — brimming with prema; kampa-sveda-adi bhave — in the bhavas of trembling, perspiration and others; rasa-anuragi — attached to rasa

53His body is overcome with thrills, brimming with prema;
in the bhavas of trembling, perspiration and others He is attached to rasa.

কলিদর্প-দমন কনক-দণ্ড করে ।
রাতা-উতপল করতল মনোহরে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

kalidarpa-damana kanaka-daṇḍa kare |
rātā-utapala karatala manohare || 54 ||

kali-darpa-damana — subduing the pride of Kali; kanaka-danda kare — a golden staff in His hand; rata-utapala — red lotuses; karatala manohare — His charming palms

54In His hand is a golden staff that subdues the pride of Kali;
His charming palms are like red lotuses.

অঙ্গদ কঙ্কণ হার কেয়ূর কিঙ্কিণী ।
গণ্ডযুগে কুণ্ডল যেমন দিনমণি ॥ ৫৫ ॥

aṅgada kaṅkaṇa hāra keẏūra kiṅkiṇī |
gaṇḍayuge kuṇḍala yemana dinamaṇi || 55 ||

angada kankana hara keyura kinkini — armlets, bracelets, necklace, upper-arm bands, belt of bells; ganda-yuge kundala — earrings by His cheeks; yemana dina-mani — like the sun

55Armlets, bracelets, necklace, upper-arm bands, a belt of bells;
by His cheeks earrings shine like the sun.11

পড়িতে পড়িতে উঠে বলিয়া 'সাম্ভাল' ।
সভাকে পুছয়ে কাহাঁ কানাঞি গোয়াল ॥ ৫৬ ॥

paṛite paṛite uṭhe baliẏā 'sāmbhāla' |
sabhāke puchaẏe kāhāṁ kānāñi goẏāla || 56 ||

padite padite — falling again and again; uthe — He rises; baliya sambhala — crying "Steady!"; sabhake puchhaye — asks everyone; kaha kananyi goyala — where is Kanai the cowherd

56Falling again and again, He rises crying: "Steady!"
and asks everyone: "Where is Kanai the cowherd?"

অলৌকিক বাল্যভাবে ক্ষণে কান্দে হাসে ।
'মধু দেহ' বলি' ক্ষণে রেবতী প্রশংসে ॥ ৫৭ ॥

alaukika bālyabhābe kṣaṇe kānde hāse |
'madhu deha' bali' kṣaṇe rebatī praśaṃse || 57 ||

alaukika balya-bhave — in an unearthly childlike mood; kshane kande hase — now weeps, now laughs; madhu deha bali — crying "Give honey!"; kshane revati prashamse — now praises Revati

57In an unearthly childlike mood He now weeps, now laughs;
now He cries: "Give Me honey!" — now praises Revati.12

ক্ষণে যুগপদ করি' লাফে লাফে যায় ।
এক বোলে আর করে বুঝনে না যায় ॥ ৫৮ ॥

kṣaṇe yugapada kari' lāphe lāphe yāẏa |
eka bole āra kare bujhane nā yāẏa || 58 ||

kshane — at times; yugapada kari — with feet together; laphe laphe yaya — goes by leaps; eka bole — says one thing; ara kare — does another; bujhane na yaya — cannot be understood

58Now, with feet together, He goes by leaps;
He says one thing and does another — there is no understanding it.

অঙ্গের সৌরভে যত যুবতীর গণ ।
কুলবতী-মদ তারা ছাড়িলা তখন ॥ ৫৯ ॥

aṅgera saurabhe yata yubatīra gaṇa |
kulabatī-mada tārā chāṛilā takhana || 59 ||

angera saurabhe — by the fragrance of His body; yata yuvatira gana — all the young women; kulavati-mada — the pride of noble wives; tara chhadila takhana — they then gave up

59By the fragrance of His body all the young women
then gave up the pride of noble wives.13

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া প্রভু পরণাম করে ।
করিল মঙ্গল-স্তুতি মধুর-অক্ষরে ॥ ৬০ ॥

bhūmite paṛiẏā prabhu paraṇāma kare |
karila maṅgala-stuti madhura-akṣare || 60 ||

bhumite padiya — falling to the ground; prabhu paranama kare — the Lord bows down; karila mangala-stuti — offered auspicious praise; madhura-akshare — in sweet words

60The Lord, falling to the ground, bowed down to Him
and offered auspicious praise in sweet words.14

পড়িলেন প্রভুপদে নিত্যানন্দরায় ।
দোঁহার চরণ ধরিবারে দোঁহে চায় ॥ ৬১ ॥

paṛilena prabhupade nityānandarāẏa |
doṁhāra caraṇa dharibāre doṁhe cāẏa || 61 ||

padilena prabhu-pade — fell at the Lord's feet; nityananda-raya — Nityananda-raya; donhara charana — each other's feet; dharibare donhe chaya — both seek to clasp

61Nityananda-raya fell at the Lord's feet:
each seeks to clasp the other's feet.

দোঁহে আলিঙ্গন করে কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ।
কতি ছিলা বলি' হাসে মুখ চাহিয়া ॥ ৬২ ॥

doṁhe āliṅgana kare kāndiẏā kāndiẏā |
kati chilā bali' hāse mukha cāhiẏā || 62 ||

donhe alingana kare — both embrace; kandiya kandiya — weeping and weeping; kati chhila bali — saying "Where have You been?"; hase mukha chahiya — they laugh, gazing at [each other's] faces

62Both embrace, weeping and weeping,
and, gazing into each other's faces, laugh: "Where have You been?"

সকল অবনী আমি ফিরিয়া আইনু ।
কোথাহ তোমার লাগি মুঞি না পাইনু ॥ ৬৩ ॥

sakala abanī āmi phiriẏā āinu |
kothāha tomāra lāgi muñi nā pāinu || 63 ||

sakala avani — the whole earth; ami phiriya ainu — I have wandered through; kothaha — nowhere; tomara lagi — any trace of You; munyi na painu — did I find

63"I have wandered through the whole earth,
but nowhere did I find any trace of You.

শুনিলাম গৌড়দেশে নবদ্বীপপুরে ।
লুকাঞা আছে তথা নন্দের কুমারে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

śunilāma gauṛadeśe nabadbīpapure |
lukāñā āche tathā nandera kumāre || 64 ||

shunilama — I heard; gauda-deshe navadvipa-pure — in the land of Gauda, in the town of Navadvipa; lukanya achhe tatha — there is hiding; nandera kumare — the son of Nanda

64I heard that in the land of Gauda, in the town of Navadvipa,
the son of Nanda is hiding.

চোর ধরিবারে মুঞি আইলাম এথা ।
ধরিলাম চোর আজি পলাইবা কোথা ॥ ৬৫ ॥

cora dharibāre muñi āilāma ethā |
dharilāma cora āji palāibā kothā || 65 ||

chora dharibare — to catch the thief; munyi ailama etha — I have come here; dharilama chora — I have caught the thief; aji palaiba kotha — where will You flee now

65To catch the thief I have come here —
I have caught the thief! Where will You flee now?"15

ইহা বলি' নিত্যানন্দ হাসে কান্দে নাচে ।
গৌরাঙ্গ আনন্দে নাচে নিত্যানন্দ-কাছে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

ihā bali' nityānanda hāse kānde nāce |
gaurāṅga ānande nāce nityānanda-kāche || 66 ||

iha bali — saying this; nityananda hase kande nache — Nityananda laughs, weeps, dances; gauranga anande nache — Gauranga dances in joy; nityananda-kachhe — beside Nityananda

66Saying this, Nityananda laughs, weeps and dances,
and Gauranga dances in joy beside Nityananda.

কলিদর্প-দমন পাইনু নিত্যানন্দ ।
তারিনু পতিত পঙ্গু জড় আদি অন্ধ ॥ ৬৭ ॥

kalidarpa-damana pāinu nityānanda |
tārinu patita paṅgu jaṛa ādi andha || 67 ||

kali-darpa-damana — the tamer of Kali's pride; painu nityananda — I have found Nityananda; tarinu — I have [as good as] delivered; patita pangu jada adi andha — the fallen, the lame, the dull and the blind

67"I have found Nityananda, the tamer of Kali's pride —
now the fallen, the lame, the dull and the blind are as good as delivered by Me!

নিত্যানন্দ-প্রতাপে পবিত্র ত্রিভুবন ।
না জানে পাষণ্ডী দুরাচার মূঢ় জন ॥ ৬৮ ॥

nityānanda-pratāpe pabitra tribhubana |
nā jāne pāṣaṇḍī durācāra mūṛha jana || 68 ||

nityananda-pratape — by the might of Nityananda; pavitra tribhuvana — the three worlds are purified; na jane — they do not know; pashandi durachara mudha jana — the godless, the wicked, the foolish

68By the might of Nityananda the three worlds are purified,
yet the godless, the wicked and the foolish do not know it.

সভাই পড়িবে পাছে নিত্যানন্দ-ফান্দে ।
এই কথা কহিলেন প্রভু গোরাচান্দে ॥ ৬৯ ॥

sabhāi paṛibe pāche nityānanda-phānde |
ei kathā kahilena prabhu gorācānde || 69 ||

sabhai — all; padibe pachhe — will later fall; nityananda-phande — into Nityananda's net; ei katha kahilena — thus spoke; prabhu gorachande — the Lord Gorachand

69But they too will all fall later into Nityananda's net" —
so spoke the Lord Gorachand.

ভূমিতে লুটাইয়া প্রভু পরণাম করে ।
কহিল বিনয়-কথা মঙ্গল-অক্ষরে ॥ ৬৯+১ ॥

bhūmite luṭāiẏā prabhu paraṇāma kare |
kahila binaẏa-kathā maṅgala-akṣare || 69+1 ||

bhumite lutaiya — prostrating on the ground; prabhu parnama kare — the Lord bows down; kahila vinaya-katha — spoke humble words; mangala-akshare — in auspicious syllables

69+1Prostrating Himself on the ground, the Lord bows down [to Him]
and speaks humble words in auspicious syllables16.

হরিগুণ-সংকীর্তন করয়ে আনন্দে ।
আপনে নাচয়ে সঙ্গে নাচে নিত্যানন্দে ॥ ৭০ ॥

hariguṇa-saṃkīrtana karaẏe ānande |
āpane nācaẏe saṅge nāce nityānande || 70 ||

hari-guna-sankirtana — sankirtana of Hari's qualities; karaye anande — He performs joyfully; apane nachaye — He Himself dances; sange nache nityanande — with Him dances Nityananda

70Joyfully He sings the sankirtana of Hari's qualities:
He Himself dances, and with Him dances Nityananda.

নৃত্য সম্বরিয়া সে বসিলা দুইজনে ।
আনন্দিত সর্বজন দেখয়ে নয়নে ॥ ৭১ ॥

nṛtya sambariẏā se basilā duijane |
ānandita sarbajana dekhaẏe naẏane || 71 ||

nritya samvariya — ending the dance; se basila duijane — the two sat down; anandita sarvajana — everyone, delighted; dekhaye nayane — beholds them

71Ending the dance, the two sat down,
and everyone gazed at Them in joy.

তবে নিত্যানন্দ-পদ-অরবিন্দ-ধূলি ।
আপনে আনিঞা দিল ভক্ত-শিরোপরি ॥ ৭২ ॥

tabe nityānanda-pada-arabinda-dhūli |
āpane āniñā dila bhakta-śiropari || 72 ||

tabe — then; nityananda-pada-aravinda-dhuli — the dust of Nityananda's lotus feet; apane aninya — Himself taking; dila bhakta-shiropari — He placed on the devotees' heads

72Then [the Lord] Himself took the dust of Nityananda's lotus feet
and placed it on the devotees' heads.

নিত্যানন্দ-পদধূলি পাঞা ভক্তগণ ।
প্রেমে গরগর চিত্ত ঝরয়ে নয়ন ॥ ৭৩ ॥

nityānanda-padadhūli pāñā bhaktagaṇa |
preme garagara citta jharaẏe naẏana || 73 ||

nityananda-pada-dhuli panya — receiving the dust of Nityananda's feet; bhaktagana — the devotees; preme garagara chitta — their hearts overflowing with prema; jharaye nayana — their eyes stream

73Receiving the dust of Nityananda's feet, the devotees —
their hearts overflowing with prema, tears streaming from their eyes.

এইমতে কৌতুকে আছিলা কথোক্ষণ ।
ঘরেরে চলিলা প্রভু শচীর নন্দন ॥ ৭৪ ॥

eimate kautuke āchilā kathokṣaṇa |
gharere calilā prabhu śacīra nandana || 74 ||

eimate — thus; kautuke — in joy; achhila kathokshana — they stayed a while; gharere chalila — went home; prabhu shachira nandana — the Lord, Shachi's son

74So they stayed there a while in joy,
and the Lord, Shachi's son, went home.

পথে যাইতে কহে নিত্যানন্দের মহিমা ।
ত্রিজগতে দিতে নাঞি ইহার উপমা ॥ ৭৫ ॥

pathe yāite kahe nityānandera mahimā |
trijagate dite nāñi ihāra upamā || 75 ||

pathe yaite — going along the road; kahe nityanandera mahima — He tells of Nityananda's glory; trijagate — in the three worlds; dite nanyi ihara upama — there is no comparison to give for Him

75Going along the road, He tells of Nityananda's glory:
"In all the three worlds there is none to compare with Him.

শুন শুন সর্বজন আমার বচন ।
কৃষ্ণ-প্রেমভক্তি এই নহে সাধারণ ॥ ৭৬ ॥

śuna śuna sarbajana āmāra bacana |
kṛṣṇa-premabhakti ei nahe sādhāraṇa || 76 ||

shuna shuna sarvajana — hear, hear, all; amara bachana — My words; krishna-prema-bhakti ei — this prema-bhakti for Krishna; nahe sadharana — is not ordinary

76Hear, hear, all of you, My words:
this prema-bhakti of His for Krishna is not ordinary.

আগে জ্ঞান হয় তবে উপজে ভকতি ।
তবে সে জনমে সর্বভোগে বিরকতি ॥ ৭৭ ॥

āge jñāna haẏa tabe upaje bhakati |
tabe se janame sarbabhoge birakati || 77 ||

age — first; jnana haya — there is knowledge; tabe upaje bhakati — then devotion arises; tabe se janame — then is born; sarva-bhoge virakati — detachment from all enjoyments

77First there is knowledge, then devotion arises,
and then comes detachment from all enjoyments.

এইমনে ক্রমে ক্রমে বাঢ়ে অনুদিন ।
কৃষ্ণ-অনুরাগ বাঢ়ে হয় পরবীণ ॥ ৭৮ ॥

eimane krame krame bāṛhe anudina |
kṛṣṇa-anurāga bāṛhe haẏa parabīṇa || 78 ||

eimane — thus; krame krame — step by step; badhe anudina — it grows day by day; krishna-anuraga badhe — attachment to Krishna grows; haya paravina — one becomes mature

78So step by step it grows day by day;
attachment to Krishna grows, and one becomes mature."17

আর দিনে মহাপ্রভু আপনার ঘরে ।
আমন্ত্রণ দিল নিত্যানন্দ ন্যাসিবরে ॥ ৭৯ ॥

āra dine mahāprabhu āpanāra ghare |
āmantraṇa dila nityānanda nyāsibare || 79 ||

ara dine — on another day; mahaprabhu apanara ghare — Mahaprabhu, to His own house; amantrana dila — invited; nityananda nyasivare — Nityananda, the best of sannyasis

79On another day Mahaprabhu
invited Nityananda, the best of sannyasis, to His own house.

ভিক্ষা-অনন্তরে অঙ্গে লেপিল চন্দনে ।
দিব্য মালা নিবেদিল পূজার বিধানে ॥ ৮০ ॥

bhikṣā-anantare aṅge lepila candane |
dibya mālā nibedila pūjāra bidhāne || 80 ||

bhiksha-anantare — after the meal; ange lepila chandane — anointed His body with sandal; divya mala nivedila — offered a divine garland; pujara vidhane — according to the rules of worship

80After the meal He anointed His body with sandal
and, according to the rules of worship, offered Him a divine garland.18

তাঁহার কৌপীন লৈয়া খণ্ড খণ্ড করি' ।
চিরিয়া বান্ধিল প্রভু ভক্ত-শিরোপরি ॥ ৮০+১ ॥

tāṁhāra kaupīna laiẏā khaṇḍa khaṇḍa kari' |
ciriẏā bāndhila prabhu bhakta-śiropari || 80+1 ||

tahara kaupina laiya — taking His kaupina; khanda khanda kari — tearing it into pieces; chiriya — rending; bandhila prabhu — the Lord tied; bhakta-shiropari — on the heads of the devotees

80+1Taking His kaupina, the Lord tore it into pieces
and tied [them] on the heads of the devotees19.

তাঁহার চরণোদক ভক্তে পিয়াইল ।
অবধূত দেখি' সবার আনন্দ বাড়িল ॥ ৮০+২ ॥

tāṁhāra caraṇodaka bhakte piẏāila |
abadhūta dekhi' sabāra ānanda bāṛila || 80+2 ||

tahara charanodaka — the water of His feet; bhakte piyaila — gave the devotees to drink; avadhuta dekhi — seeing the Avadhuta; sabara ananda badila — everyone's joy increased

80+2He gave the devotees the water of His feet to drink;
seeing the Avadhuta, everyone's joy increased.

নাচে গায় সে করে হুঙ্কার গর্জন ।
প্রেমে পরিপূর্ণ দেখে অনন্ত ভুবন ॥ ৮০+৩ ॥

nāce gāẏa se kare huṅkāra garjana |
preme paripūrṇa dekhe ananta bhubana || 80+3 ||

nache gaya — dances, sings; se kare hunkara garjana — He roars and thunders; preme paripurna — filled with prema; dekhe ananta bhuvana — sees the endless worlds

80+3He dances and sings, He roars and thunders,
and sees the endless worlds filled with prema.

নিত্যানন্দ মহাপ্রভু পরম উল্লাসে ।
গৌরচন্দ্র-মুখ হেরি' অট্ট অট্ট হাসে ॥ ৮০+৪ ॥

nityānanda mahāprabhu parama ullāse |
gauracandra-mukha heri' aṭṭa aṭṭa hāse || 80+4 ||

nityananda mahaprabhu — Nityananda Mahaprabhu; parama ullase — in supreme delight; gaurachandra-mukha heri — looking at Gaurachandra's face; atta atta hase — laughs aloud

80+4Nityananda Mahaprabhu, in supreme delight,
looking at Gaurachandra's face, laughs aloud.

পদতালে ধরণী সে থির নাহি হয় ।
ভূমিকম্প হেন সবে মানিল নিশ্চয় ॥ ৮০+৫ ॥

padatāle dharaṇī se thira nāhi haẏa |
bhūmikampa hena sabe mānila niścaẏa || 80+5 ||

padatale — by the stamping of the feet; dharani se thira nahi haya — the earth does not stay still; bhumikampa hena — as if an earthquake; sabe manila nishchaya — all were sure

80+5Under the stamping of His feet the earth cannot stay still:
everyone took it for an earthquake.

নাচে গৌরচন্দ্র প্রভু সবার ঠাকুর ।
ক্ষণে ক্ষণে বাড়ে প্রেম-হিল্লোল প্রচুর ॥ ৮০+৬ ॥

nāce gauracandra prabhu sabāra ṭhākura |
kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bāṛe prema-hillola pracura || 80+6 ||

nache — dances; gaurachandra prabhu — Gaurachandra Prabhu; sabara thakura — the Master of all; kshane kshane — moment by moment; bade — swell; prema-hillola prachura — abundant waves of prema

80+6Gaurachandra Prabhu, the Master of all, dances;
moment by moment the abundant waves of prema swell.

দেখিয়া ত শচীদেবী আনন্দিত চিত ।
নিত্যানন্দ দেখি' বিশ্বরূপ পরতীত ॥ ৮০+৭ ॥

dekhiẏā ta śacīdebī ānandita cita |
nityānanda dekhi' biśbarūpa paratīta || 80+7 ||

dekhiya ta — seeing this; shachidevi — Shachi-devi; anandita chita — rejoiced at heart; nityananda dekhi — looking at Nityananda; vishvarupa paratita — recognized Vishvarupa

80+7Seeing this, Shachi-devi rejoiced at heart:
looking at Nityananda, she recognized Vishvarupa [in Him].

বধূ-সঙ্গে গৃহে করে পরম মঙ্গল ।
হুলাহুলি জয়ধ্বনি করে সুমঙ্গল ॥ ৮০+৮ ॥

badhū-saṅge gṛhe kare parama maṅgala |
hulāhuli jaẏadhbani kare sumaṅgala || 80+8 ||

vadhu-sange — with her daughter-in-law; grihe — in the house; kare parama mangala — holds a great festivity; hulahuli — cries of "ulu-ulu"; jaya-dhvani — cries of "Jaya!"; kare sumangala — raises auspicious

80+8Together with her daughter-in-law she holds a great festivity in the house:
auspicious cries of "ulu-ulu" and "Jaya!"

নিত্যানন্দে দেখি' আজ বিশ্বরূপ-ঠান ।
একদিঠে চাহে দেবী হরষিত-পরাণ ॥ ৮০+৯ ॥

nityānande dekhi' āja biśbarūpa-ṭhāna |
ekadiṭhe cāhe debī haraṣita-parāṇa || 80+9 ||

nityanande dekhi — seeing in Nityananda; aja — today; vishvarupa-thana — the likeness of Vishvarupa; ekadithe chahe devi — the goddess gazes fixedly; harashita-parana — her heart rejoicing

80+9Seeing Vishvarupa in Nityananda today,
the goddess gazes [at Him] fixedly, her heart rejoicing.

গৌরচন্দ্র কহে কথা শুন বাপ মোর ।
বিশ্বরূপ সেই পুত্র সহোদর তোর ॥ ৮০+১০ ॥

gauracandra kahe kathā śuna bāpa mora |
biśbarūpa sei putra sahodara tora || 80+10 ||

gaurachandra kahe katha — Gaurachandra says; shuna bapa mora — listen, dear one (lit. "my father", an endearment); vishvarupa sei putra — Vishvarupa, that very son; sahodara tora — your own (lit. "uterine")

80+10Gaurachandra says: "Listen, dear one:
this is Vishvarupa — that very son, your own [son].

নিত্যানন্দ নাম ধরি' আইলা নবদ্বীপে ।
মোর বাপ বিশ্বম্ভর রাখহ সমীপে ॥ ৮০+১১ ॥

nityānanda nāma dhari' āilā nabadbīpe |
mora bāpa biśbambhara rākhaha samīpe || 80+11 ||

nityananda nama dhari — taking the name Nityananda; aila navadvipe — came to Navadvipa; mora bapa vishvambhara — my dear Vishvambhara; rakhaha samipe — keep near you

80+11Under the name of Nityananda He has come to Navadvipa;
keep Him by you, [like] your dear Vishvambhara."

কহিতেই দেবী তবে আনন্দ-পাথারে ।
ডুবি' নিত্যানন্দে চাহে কোলে করিবারে ॥ ৮০+১২ ॥

kahitei debī tabe ānanda-pāthāre |
ḍubi' nityānande cāhe kole karibāre || 80+12 ||

kahitei — as soon as He said; devi tabe — the goddess then; ananda-pathare dubi — plunged in an ocean of bliss; nityanande chahe — wants Nityananda; kole karibare — to take on her lap

80+12As soon as He said this, the goddess, plunged in an ocean of bliss,
wants to take Nityananda on her lap.

আইস বাপ বিশ্বরূপ চুম্বি' মুখ তার ।
হরিষে না জানি চিত কি করে মোর ॥ ৮০+১৩ ॥

āisa bāpa biśbarūpa cumbi' mukha tāra |
hariṣe nā jāni cita ki kare mora || 80+13 ||

aisa bapa vishvarupa — come, my son Vishvarupa; chumbi mukha tara — kissing His face; harishe — for joy; na jani — I know not; chita ki kare mora — what my heart is doing

80+13"Come, my son Vishvarupa!" — and she kisses His face.
"For joy I know not what is happening to my heart!"

কহে গৌরচন্দ্র মাগো না হও উতরোল ।
রাখহ গোপতে কথা শুন মোর বোল ॥ ৮০+১৪ ॥

kahe gauracandra māgo nā hao utarola |
rākhaha gopate kathā śuna mora bola || 80+14 ||

kahe gaurachandra — Gaurachandra says; mago — mother; na hao utarola — do not be agitated; rakhaha gopate katha — keep this secret; shuna mora bola — listen to My word

80+14Gaurachandra says: "Mother, do not be agitated;
keep this secret — listen to My word."

নিত্যানন্দ মহাপ্রভু আইর চরণে ।
দণ্ডবৎ পরণাম করয়ে যতনে ॥ ৮০+১৫ ॥

nityānanda mahāprabhu āira caraṇe |
daṇḍabat paraṇāma karaẏe yatane || 80+15 ||

nityananda mahaprabhu — Nityananda Mahaprabhu; aira charane — at the feet of Ai (Shachi); dandavat parnama karaye — prostrates Himself; yatane — with care

80+15Nityananda Mahaprabhu at the feet of Ai (mother Shachi)
prostrates Himself with care.

চরণের ধূলি লয় দু'হাতে করিয়া ।
আইর সন্তোষে নাচে হরিষ হইয়া ॥ ৮০+১৬ ॥

caraṇera dhūli laẏa du'hāte kariẏā |
āira santoṣe nāce hariṣa haiẏā || 80+16 ||

charanera dhuli laya — takes the dust of the feet; du-hate kariya — with both hands; aira santoshe — to Ai's delight; nache — dances; harisha haiya — rejoicing

80+16With both hands He takes the dust of her feet
and, rejoicing, dances to Ai's delight.

কতক্ষণে হইলেন স্থির সবে মিলি' ।
নিত্যানন্দ মহাপ্রভু মহাকুতূহলী ॥ ৮০+১৭ ॥

katakṣaṇe hailena sthira sabe mili' |
nityānanda mahāprabhu mahākutūhalī || 80+17 ||

katakshane — after a while; hailena sthira — grew calm; sabe mili — all together; nityananda mahaprabhu — Nityananda Mahaprabhu; maha-kutuhali — full of great merriment

80+17After a while all together grew calm;
Nityananda Mahaprabhu [was] full of great merriment.

নিত্যানন্দ দেখি' শচীর জুড়াইল নয়ান ।
পিরীতি-পাগল হঞা নেহারে বয়ান ॥ ৮১ ॥

nityānanda dekhi' śacīra juṛāila naẏāna |
pirīti-pāgala hañā nehāre baẏāna || 81 ||

nityananda dekhi — seeing Nityananda; shachira judaila nayana — Shachi's eyes were soothed; piriti-pagala hanya — beside herself with love; nehare bayana — she gazes at [His] face

81Seeing Nityananda, Shachi's eyes were soothed;
beside herself with love, she gazes at His face.

প্রভু বোলে নিজপুত্র বলিয়া জানিবে ।
আমারে অধিক করি' ইহারে পালিবে ॥ ৮২ ॥

prabhu bole nijaputra baliẏā jānibe |
āmāre adhika kari' ihāre pālibe || 82 ||

prabhu bole — the Lord says; nija-putra baliya janibe — know [Him] as your own son; amare adhika kari — more than Me; ihare palibe — care for Him

82The Lord says: "Know Him as your own son
and care for Him more than for Me."

পুত্রভাবে শচী নিত্যানন্দ-মুখ চাহে ।
মোর পুত্র তুমি হৈলা শচীদেবী কহে ॥ ৮৩ ॥

putrabhābe śacī nityānanda-mukha cāhe |
mora putra tumi hailā śacīdebī kahe || 83 ||

putra-bhave — in the mood of a son; shachi nityananda-mukha chahe — Shachi gazes at Nityananda's face; mora putra tumi haila — you have become my son; shachidevi kahe — says Shachi-devi

83As on a son, Shachi gazes at Nityananda's face.
"You have become my son," says Shachi-devi.

মোর বিশ্বম্ভরে কৃপা করিবে আপনে ।
আজি হৈতে তোরা দুই আমার নন্দনে ॥ ৮৪ ॥

mora biśbambhare kṛpā karibe āpane |
āji haite torā dui āmāra nandane || 84 ||

mora vishvambhare — to my Vishvambhara; kripa karibe apane — be kind yourself; aji haite — from today; tora dui — you two; amara nandane — are my sons

84"Be kind yourself to my Vishvambhara:
from today you two are my sons."

বলিতে বলিতে শচীর অশ্রু নেত্রে ঝরে ।
পুত্রভাবে শচী নিত্যানন্দ কোলে করে ॥ ৮৫ ॥

balite balite śacīra aśru netre jhare |
putrabhābe śacī nityānanda kole kare || 85 ||

balite balite — as she speaks; shachira ashru netre jhare — tears stream from Shachi's eyes; putra-bhave — as a son; shachi nityananda kole kare — Shachi takes Nityananda in her arms

85As she speaks, tears stream from Shachi's eyes,
and Shachi takes Nityananda in her arms as a son.

নিত্যানন্দ মাতৃভাবে শচীর চরণে ।
দণ্ডবৎ করি' বোলে মধুর বচনে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

nityānanda mātṛbhābe śacīra caraṇe |
daṇḍabat kari' bole madhura bacane || 86 ||

nityananda matri-bhave — Nityananda, in the mood of a son to his mother; shachira charane — at Shachi's feet; dandavat kari — prostrating; bole madhura bachane — speaks in sweet words

86Nityananda, seeing her as His mother, prostrated Himself
at Shachi's feet and speaks in sweet words:

যে কহিলে মাতা তুমি সব সত্য হয় ।
তব পুত্র হই আমি জানিহ নিশ্চয় ॥ ৮৭ ॥

ye kahile mātā tumi saba satya haẏa |
taba putra hai āmi jāniha niścaẏa || 87 ||

ye kahile mata tumi — what you have said, mother; saba satya haya — is all true; tava putra hai ami — I am your son; janiha nishchaya — know for certain

87"All that you have said, mother, is true:
I am your son — know it for certain.

পুত্র-অপরাধ কিছু না লইবে মাতা ।
তব পুত্র বটি মুঞি জানিবে সর্বথা ॥ ৮৮ ॥

putra-aparādha kichu nā laibe mātā |
taba putra baṭi muñi jānibe sarbathā || 88 ||

putra-aparadha kichhu — any offences of your son; na laibe mata — do not hold against me, mother; tava putra bati munyi — I am truly your son; janibe sarvatha — know it in every way

88Do not hold your son's offences against Him, mother:
know it in every way — I am truly your son."

নিত্যানন্দের মাতৃভাব পাঞা শচীরাণী ।
নয়নে গলয়ে জল গদগদ বাণী ॥ ৮৯ ॥

nityānandera mātṛbhāba pāñā śacīrāṇī |
naẏane galaẏe jala gadagada bāṇī || 89 ||

nityanandera matri-bhava panya — receiving Nityananda's love for her as mother; shachirani — queen Shachi; nayane galaye jala — tears flow from her eyes; gadagada vani — her voice falters

89Receiving Nityananda's love as a son, queen Shachi —
tears flow from her eyes, her voice falters.

এইমতে স্নেহরসে সভে গরগর ।
দুই পুত্র দেখি' শচীর জুড়াইল অন্তর ॥ ৯০ ॥

eimate sneharase sabhe garagara |
dui putra dekhi' śacīra juṛāila antara || 90 ||

eimate — thus; sneha-rase — in the rasa of affection; sabhe garagara — all overflow; dui putra dekhi — seeing her two sons; shachira judaila antara — Shachi's heart was soothed

90Thus all overflow with the rasa of affection;
seeing her two sons, Shachi was comforted at heart.20

আর দিন শ্রীবাস-পণ্ডিত ভিক্ষা দিল ।
তাঁহার আশ্রমে অবধূত ভিক্ষা কৈল ॥ ৯১ ॥

āra dina śrībāsa-paṇḍita bhikṣā dila |
tāṁhāra āśrame abadhūta bhikṣā kaila || 91 ||

ara dina — on another day; shrivasa-pandita bhiksha dila — Srivasa Pandita offered a meal; tanhara ashrame — in his house; avadhuta bhiksha kaila — the Avadhuta took the meal

91On another day Srivasa Pandita offered a meal,
and the Avadhuta took the meal in his house.

অনেক সন্তোষ পাইল পণ্ডিতের ঠাঞি ।
ভিক্ষা করি' সেই দিন রহিলা তথাই ॥ ৯২ ॥

aneka santoṣa pāila paṇḍitera ṭhāñi |
bhikṣā kari' sei dina rahilā tathāi || 92 ||

aneka santosha paila — found great satisfaction; panditera thanyi — with the Pandita; bhiksha kari — having taken the meal; sei dina rahila tathai — that day He stayed there

92He found great satisfaction with the Pandita
and, having taken the meal, stayed there that day.

সেইক্ষণে মহাপ্রভু গৌর ভগবান্ ।
শ্রীবাস-ভবনে গেলা প্রসন্ন-বয়ান ॥ ৯৩ ॥

seikṣaṇe mahāprabhu gaura bhagabān |
śrībāsa-bhabane gelā prasanna-baẏāna || 93 ||

seikshane — at that moment; mahaprabhu gaura bhagavan — Mahaprabhu Gaura Bhagavan; shrivasa-bhavane gela — went to Srivasa's house; prasanna-bayana — with a serene face

93At that very moment Mahaprabhu Gaura Bhagavan
came with a serene face to Srivasa's house.

দেবালয়ে প্রবেশিয়া বৈসে দিব্যাসনে ।
কহিল আমারে এই দেখহ নয়নে ॥ ৯৪ ॥

debālaẏe prabeśiẏā baise dibyāsane |
kahila āmāre ei dekhaha naẏane || 94 ||

devalaye praveshiya — entering the shrine room; baise divya-asane — sits on a divine seat; kahila — He said; amare ei dekhaha nayane — behold Me now with Your eyes

94Entering the shrine room, He sits on a divine seat
and said: "Behold Me now with Your eyes."

এ বোল শুনিঞা নিত্যানন্দ ন্যাসিবর ।
সাদরে নিরিখে বিশ্বম্ভর-কলেবর ॥ ৯৫ ॥

e bola śuniñā nityānanda nyāsibara |
sādare nirikhe biśbambhara-kalebara || 95 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing these words; nityananda nyasivara — Nityananda, the best of sannyasis; sadare nirikhe — lovingly gazes at; vishvambhara-kalevara — the form of Vishvambhara

95Hearing these words, Nityananda, the best of sannyasis,
lovingly gazes at the form of Vishvambhara.

তত্ত্ব না জানিল কিছু বিশেষ তাহার ।
কি কাজ কহিল প্রভু ইঙ্গিত-আকার ॥ ৯৬ ॥

tattba nā jānila kichu biśeṣa tāhāra |
ki kāja kahila prabhu iṅgita-ākāra || 96 ||

tattva na janila — He did not grasp the truth; kichhu vishesha tahara — of any special [meaning] in it; ki kaja kahila prabhu — what purpose the Lord spoke of; ingita-akara — by a hint

96But He did not grasp any special meaning in this —
what purpose the Lord had hinted at.

তবে পুনরপি মহাপ্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
নিজজন দেখি' কিছু কহিল উত্তর ॥ ৯৭ ॥

tabe punarapi mahāprabhu biśbambhara |
nijajana dekhi' kichu kahila uttara || 97 ||

tabe punarapi — then again; mahaprabhu vishvambhara — Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara; nijajana dekhi — looking at His own; kichhu kahila uttara — said something in reply

97Then Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara again,
looking at His own, said to them in reply:

সর্বজন হও এই মন্দির-বাহিরে ।
মন্দির বাহির হৈলা আজ্ঞা পালিবারে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

sarbajana hao ei mandira-bāhire |
mandira bāhira hailā ājñā pālibāre || 98 ||

sarvajana hao — all of you go; ei mandira-bahire — out of this room; mandira bahira haila — they went out of the room; ajna palibare — to obey the command

98"All of you, go out of this room" —
and they went out of the room, obeying the command.

অবশেষ কথা কিবা কহে আপনার ।
নিভৃতে কহয়ে মর্ম কে জানিবে তার ॥ ৯৯ ॥

abaśeṣa kathā kibā kahe āpanāra |
nibhṛte kahaẏe marma ke jānibe tāra || 99 ||

avashesha katha — the remaining words; kiba kahe apanara — what He says of Himself; nibhrite kahaye — He speaks in private; marma — the inner meaning; ke janibe tara — who will know it

99What He says of Himself in the remaining words —
the inner meaning spoken in private — who will know?

কহিল আমারে এই দেখহ আপনে ।
আমার কারণে তুমি কৈলে পরিশ্রমে ॥ ১০০ ॥

kahila āmāre ei dekhaha āpane |
āmāra kāraṇe tumi kaile pariśrame || 100 ||

kahila — He said; amare ei dekhaha apane — behold Me now Yourself; amara karane — for My sake; tumi kaile parishrame — You have toiled

100He said: "Behold Me now Yourself:
for My sake You have toiled so much."

ষড়্ভুজ শরীর প্রভু দেখাইল আগে ।
তবে চতুর্ভুজ রূপ দুই ভুজ তবে ॥ ১০১ ॥

ṣaṛbhuja śarīra prabhu dekhāila āge |
tabe caturbhuja rūpa dui bhuja tabe || 101 ||

shadbhuja sharira — the six-armed body; prabhu dekhaila age — the Lord showed first; tabe chaturbhuja rupa — then the four-armed form; dui bhuja tabe — then two-armed

101First the Lord showed His six-armed form,
then the four-armed form, and then the two-armed.

দেখিয়া ঐছন রূপ অতি অদ্ভুত ।
পূর্ব সঙরিলা নিত্যানন্দ অবধূত ॥ ১০২ ॥

dekhiẏā aichana rūpa ati adbhuta |
pūrba saṅarilā nityānanda abadhūta || 102 ||

dekhiya aichhana rupa — seeing such a form; ati adbhuta — most wonderful; purva sangarila — remembered the past; nityananda avadhuta — Nityananda Avadhuta

102Seeing such a form, the greatest of wonders,
Nityananda Avadhuta remembered the past.21

দেখিল আমার প্রভু প্রকাশ হইলা ।
এক অঙ্গে তিন অবতার দেখাইলা ॥ ১০৩ ॥

dekhila āmāra prabhu prakāśa hailā |
eka aṅge tina abatāra dekhāilā || 103 ||

dekhila — He saw; amara prabhu prakasha haila — my Lord revealed Himself; eka ange — in one body; tina avatara dekhaila — He showed three avataras

103He saw: my Lord revealed Himself
and in one body showed three avataras.

রাম কৃষ্ণ গৌরাঙ্গ দেখিল দিব্য তনু ।
পশ্চাৎ দেখিল নব-কিশোর রাধাকানু ॥ ১০৪ ॥

rāma kṛṣṇa gaurāṅga dekhila dibya tanu |
paścāt dekhila naba-kiśora rādhākānu || 104 ||

rama krishna gauranga — Rama, Krishna, Gauranga; dekhila divya tanu — He saw in divine bodies; pashchat dekhila — afterwards He saw; nava-kishora radhakanu — the youthful Radha and Kanu

104He saw the divine forms of Rama, Krishna and Gauranga,
and afterwards saw the youthful pair — Radha and Kanu.22

হরিষে নাচয়ে প্রভু আনন্দ অপার ।
দিগ্বিদিগ্ নাহি জানে প্রেমের পাথার ॥ ১০৫ ॥

hariṣe nācaẏe prabhu ānanda apāra |
digbidig nāhi jāne premera pāthāra || 105 ||

harishe nachaye prabhu — in delight Prabhu dances; ananda apara — boundless bliss; digvidig nahi jane — He knows no directions; premera pathara — an ocean of prema

105In delight Prabhu dances, His bliss boundless;
He knows no directions — an ocean of prema.

হেন অদ্ভুত কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
গোরা-গুণগাথা কহে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১০৬ ॥

hena adbhuta kathā śuna sarbajana |
gorā-guṇagāthā kahe e dāsa locana || 106 ||

hena adbhuta katha — such a wondrous story; shuna sarvajana — hear, all; gora-guna-gatha — the song of Gora's qualities; kahe e dasa lochana — tells this servant Lochana

106Hear, all of you, this wondrous story:
this servant Lochana tells the song of Gora's qualities.

Raga — any (yatha-raga); refrain: "Hari, Rama, Narayana — golden Gora, Shachi's darling! At the festival of Nityananda's joy the enraptured devotees dance"

পরম অদ্ভুত কথা লোকে অবিদিত ।
শুনহ ভকত সব হৈয়া একচিত ॥ ১০৬+১ ॥

parama adbhuta kathā loke abidita |
śunaha bhakata saba haiẏā ekacita || 106+1 ||

parama adbhuta katha — a supremely wondrous story; loke avidita — unknown to people; shunaha bhakata saba — hear, all you devotees; haiya ekachita — with one-pointed mind

106+1A supremely wondrous story, unknown to people —
hear it, all you devotees, with one-pointed mind23.

ষড়্‌ভুজ দেখয়ে নিত্যানন্দ সুবিলাসী ।
বাঢ়ে নিত্যানন্দ-সুখ অমিয়ার রাশি ॥ ১০৬+২ ॥

ṣaṛ‌bhuja dekhaẏe nityānanda subilāsī |
bāṛhe nityānanda-sukha amiẏāra rāśi || 106+2 ||

shad-bhuja dekhaye — sees the six-armed [form]; nityananda suvilasi — Nityananda, graceful in play; badhe nityananda-sukha — Nityananda's happiness grows; amiyara rashi — a heap of nectar

106+2Nityananda, so graceful in His play, sees the six-armed [form];
Nityananda's happiness grows — a heap of nectar.

ঊর্ধ্ব দুই হস্তে দেখে ধনু আর শর ।
মধ্য দুই হস্তে বক্ষে মুরলী অধর ॥ ১০৬+৩ ॥

ūrdhba dui haste dekhe dhanu āra śara |
madhya dui haste bakṣe muralī adhara || 106+3 ||

urdhva dui haste — in the two upper hands; dekhe — sees; dhanu ara shara — bow and arrows; madhya dui haste — in the two middle hands; vakshe — at the breast; murali adhara — the flute at the lips

106+3In the two upper hands He sees bow and arrows;
in the two middle ones — the flute, [raised] at the breast to the lips.

অধো হস্তদ্বয়ে শোভে কমণ্ডলু দণ্ড ।
মালসাট মারে দেখি' পরম প্রচণ্ড ॥ ১০৬+৪ ॥

adho hastadbaẏe śobhe kamaṇḍalu daṇḍa |
mālasāṭa māre dekhi' parama pracaṇḍa || 106+4 ||

adho hasta-dvaye — in the two lower hands; shobhe — shine; kamandalu danda — waterpot and staff; malasata mare — slaps His arms (as a wrestler challenging); dekhi — seeing; parama prachanda — very fiercely

106+4In the two lower hands shine the waterpot and the staff.
Seeing this, [Nityananda] fiercely slaps His arms24.

রাম কৃষ্ণ গৌরাঙ্গ মাধুরী মনোহর ।
কিশোর-শেখর রসময় কলেবর ॥ ১০৬+৫ ॥

rāma kṛṣṇa gaurāṅga mādhurī manohara |
kiśora-śekhara rasamaẏa kalebara || 106+5 ||

rama krishna gauranga — Rama, Krishna, Gauranga; madhuri manohara — captivating sweetness; kishora-shekhara — crown of youths; rasamaya kalebara — a body full of rasa

106+5The captivating sweetness of Rama, Krishna and Gauranga;
the crown of youths — a body full of rasa.

দেখি' নিত্যানন্দ প্রভু সন্তোষ-অন্তর ।
লীলাবেশে হৈলা গৌর-রসে গরগর ॥ ১০৬+৬ ॥

dekhi' nityānanda prabhu santoṣa-antara |
līlābeśe hailā gaura-rase garagara || 106+6 ||

dekhi — seeing; nityananda prabhu — Nityananda Prabhu; santosha-antara — glad at heart; lilaveshe — in the mood of the lila; haila gaura-rase garagara — overflowed with the rasa of Gaura

106+6Seeing this, Nityananda Prabhu, His heart glad,
entering the mood of the lila, overflowed with the rasa of Gaura.

তবে গভীর গরজে ঘন ঘন ।
মত্ত বলদেব যেন অঙ্গের গঠন ॥ ১০৬+৭ ॥

tabe gabhīra garaje ghana ghana |
matta baladeba yena aṅgera gaṭhana || 106+7 ||

tabe — then; gabhira garaje — roars deeply; ghana ghana — again and again; matta baladeva yena — just like the intoxicated Baladeva; angera gathana — in the build of His body

106+7Then again and again He gives a deep roar;
in the build of His body He is just like the intoxicated Baladeva.

সে রূপ দেখিতে কামদেব মুরছায় ।
তুলনা দিবারে কিবা আছয়ে ধরায় ॥ ১০৬+৮ ॥

se rūpa dekhite kāmadeba murachāẏa |
tulanā dibāre kibā āchaẏe dharāẏa || 106+8 ||

Notes

  1. The summary covers the whole section (vv. 1–106). Some places in the OCR of the edition are illegible and have been restored by sense (in square brackets). The section as a whole follows Murari Gupta (2.7–2.8).
  2. So also in Murari (2.7.7): "Shri is devotion, and you are its abode."
  3. Gopinatha is a brahmana of Navadvipa, an associate of the Lord; in Murari (2.7.8): "You are known as My servant."
  4. Vv. 7–8 are the first two stanzas of Murari Gupta's Ramashtaka (eight verses on Rama) (Murari 2.7.10–11); Brihaspati and Kavi (Shukra) are the planets Jupiter and Venus. Murari is a devotee of Rama, in Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition Hanuman (en/24, note 12). Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and translation of the verses are not translated here or below.
  5. Cf. Murari 2.7.18. Ramadasa means "servant of Rama".
  6. This instruction is not in Murari. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 15.137–157) the Lord, testing Murari, advises him to worship Krishna, and then glorifies his unshakeable fidelity to Rama. Cf. also en/24, where the Lord instructs Murari to worship Radha and Krishna.
  7. The verse is Bhagavata 11.14.20; vv. 18–23 — cf. Murari 2.7.19–23. Sri Rama Pandita is the younger brother of Srivasa (Srinivasa).
  8. Cf. Murari 2.7.25–27; in Murari the remnants of the meal are received also by Narayani, Srivasa's niece, the future mother of Vrindavana Dasa.
  9. Cf. Murari 2.8.1–9. Shripada is a respectful address to a sannyasi; an Avadhuta is a wandering renunciant who stands above external rules. Rama is Sri Rama Pandita; Mukunda is Mukunda Datta. According to the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya-khanda), Nityananda came to Navadvipa after many years of pilgrimage and stayed in the house of Nandana Acharya.
  10. Literally "consider, all, your own dwelling"; so in A and in the 1983 edition. We understand it from v. 37 and from Murari (2.8.6–7), where the Lord says the Avadhuta can be found in the evening and sends everyone home.
  11. Vv. 47–55 describe Nityananda. According to Gaudiya Vaishnava theology Nityananda is Balarama Himself, Krishna's elder brother (cf. Murari 2.9.12); His staff, roar and gait "subdue Kali" — that is, His mercy breaks the power of the age of Kali. The yellow cloth is Lochana Dasa's; in Murari (2.9.12) Balarama wears blue.
  12. Nityananda is in the mood of Balarama: Kanai is Krishna, His younger brother; Revati is Balarama's consort; "honey" (madhu) is the intoxicating honey-wine (varuni) that Balarama drinks (cf. Murari 2.9.12, 2.14). This intoxication is the ecstasy of prema, not worldly drunkenness; the Avadhuta's strange behaviour (vv. 56–58) is likewise a manifestation of prema.
  13. An image from the songs of the gopis, as in Lochana Dasa's descriptions of Gaura (cf. en/09, note 9, on "nagari-bhava"): the beauty of the Lord and His associates draws souls away from worldly attachments; it is not worldly passion.
  14. Cf. Murari 2.8.10–13: the Lord bows to Nityananda with devotion. Thus the Lord honours Nityananda as His elder brother (Balarama) and shows how to honour a Vaishnava.
  15. Nityananda had wandered for many years through the holy places in search of Krishna, and found Him "hiding" in Navadvipa in the form of Gaura. The "thief" is Krishna, the Stealer of butter and of hearts.
  16. V. 69+1 is found only in the 1983 edition (the 1903 edition lacks it); it nearly repeats v. 60.
  17. Vv. 75–78 — cf. Murari 2.8.15–16. "Knowledge" here is the knowledge of Krishna as Bhagavan Himself (cf. en/27, note 2); according to Gaudiya Vaishnava teaching, devotion itself brings both knowledge and detachment (Bhagavata 1.2.7; 11.2.42).
  18. Cf. Murari 2.8.18–19.
  19. Vv. 80+1 — 80+17 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition gives vv. 80+1 — 80+16 in a footnote as an additional reading. By distributing pieces of the Avadhuta's kaupina to the devotees and giving them the water of His feet to drink, the Lord teaches them to honour Nityananda as the supreme guru (cf. the Chaitanya-bhagavata, Madhya-khanda, where the Lord likewise has the devotees tie pieces of Nityananda's kaupina on their heads). Shachi recognizes in Nityananda her elder son Vishvarupa: according to Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding, Nityananda is Balarama Himself and Vishvarupa an expansion of Sankarshana, and tradition holds that Vishvarupa, on leaving this world, entered into Nityananda; cf. also the Chaitanya-bhagavata, where Shachi sees Nityananda and Nimai in a dream as Balarama and Krishna. Vv. 80+10 — 80+11 are not quite clear in either edition (lit. "listen, my father" — an endearment; "Vishvarupa — that son, your uterine…"; "keep my dear Vishvambhara near you"); they are translated by sense.
  20. Vv. 81–90 are not in Murari. Nityananda, according to Gaudiya Vaishnava theology, is Balarama, and Vishvarupa too is an expansion of Sankarshana; hence Shachi naturally loves Nityananda as her son.
  21. Vv. 91–102 — cf. Murari 2.8.20–29. "The past" is His former pastimes with Krishna as Balarama (in Murari, 2.8.29, the Lord says: "You are My brother who sported in Vrindavana!"). In Murari Nityananda tells no one of what He saw.
  22. The six-armed form unites Rama (bow and arrows), Krishna (flute) and Gaura the sannyasi (staff and waterpot); by tradition, the Lord also revealed the same form to Sarvabhauma (en/45, vv. 243–245 and note 22; according to the Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 6, Sarvabhauma sees a four-armed and then a two-armed form). The vision of Radha and Krishna in Gaura: according to Gaudiya Vaishnava theology, Gaura is Radha and Krishna in one body (cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4; Madhya 8, Ramananda Raya's vision).
  23. The song of vv. 106+1 — 106+30 is found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition, where a new section begins at once); the 1903 edition gives it in a footnote as an additional reading. Nityananda sees the six-armed form (see note 22) and then abides in the bhava of Balarama: He calls the cowherd boys and cows of Vraja and asks Kanai (Krishna) for honey. This bhava is His own: according to Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding, Nityananda is Balarama Himself (the comparison "just like the intoxicated Baladeva" in v. 106+7 is poetic). In vv. 106+26 — 106+29 the Lord recalls with Him the pastimes in Vraja, as Krishna with His elder brother.
  24. Slapping one's arms (malasat) is the gesture of a wrestler challenging to a fight; this is Balarama's heroic mood.
  25. Vv. 106+12 — 106+14 are Lochana Dasa's nagari-bhava motif, here transferred to Nityananda (see en/09, note 9); the subject is the Lord's beauty that captivates hearts, not worldly passion.
  26. Honey (madhu) and varuni (106+17) are the intoxicating drink Balarama loves; Nityananda's "intoxication" is the ecstasy of prema, not worldly intoxication (cf. note 12).
